basics.name: Sebastian Hoyos Chartuni
basics.label: Admissions · University Operations · Technical Support
basics.summary: Bilingual admissions and operations professional with experience in higher education, student services, and technical support. Currently pursuing an MBA in Artificial Intelligence at Atlantis University. Experienced in guiding prospective students through the enrollment process, managing admissions documentation, supporting financial operations, and working in fast-paced customer-facing environments. Combines strong communication skills in English and Spanish with an analytical approach to records, technology, and process improvement.

work.name: United International College (UIC)
highlights: Handled end-to-end admissions activities, including prospective-student guidance, documentation, and application follow-up.
Collaborated to enroll approximately 85 domestic and international students during the most recent admissions cycle.
Advised students and families in Spanish and English, explaining admissions requirements and institutional processes.
Supported students with institutional procedures related to F-1 status, change of status, OPT, and CPT, within the scope of the role.
Managed accounts payable activities outside payroll, tracking payment information and supporting routine financial operations.

work.name: Geeks Hollywood
highlights: Handle customer intake, smartphone and laptop diagnostics and repairs, sales, and day-to-day store operations, contributing to average daily sales of $1.3K–$1.8K Monday through Saturday.
Designed and developed a web-based repair-order tracking application for device intake, ticket numbering, repair-status tracking, and customer lookup; currently in testing/pre-launch.

work.name: Gamepoint Miami
highlights: Helped open the location and supported day-to-day floor operations alongside the owners.

work.name: Cinco Restaurante
highlights: Progressed from customer service to kitchen operations, supporting daily restaurant service.

work.name: Universidad de la Costa (CUC)
highlights: Supported marketing, outreach, and admissions activities for prospective students while completing Civil Engineering coursework.
Contributed to institutional activities during the university's accreditation process.
